contact.desc: Запишитесь на консультацию или заполните форму заявки.
contact.desc2: Мы рассмотрим проект и ответим за 24 часа.

items.title: Numbers first
items.body: Most of your ad spend works. You just don't know which part. I put every number in one system, so you do.

items.title: Paid traffic
items.body: Your budget is set up to buy cheap leads. I set it up to buy paying customers.

items.title: Sales automation
items.body: While your lead waits, a competitor is already talking to them. I set up the system that answers first, qualifies, and logs the deal itself.

items.title: AI where it pays off
items.body: Your team spends hours on reports, CRM entries and paperwork. AI does that in minutes. I find where it fits and put it there.

items.title: Direct bookings
items.body: Booking.com takes 15–20% of every reservation. I move that demand onto the property itself, so the money stays with the owner.

items.label: How it starts
items.body: It starts with a look at what you already have. Channels, numbers, tools. Then I tell you what I'd change and what it costs, and you decide whether to go ahead.

items.label: The team
items.body: I run FT Agency. I put people from it on a project when it needs them. You don't manage them, you don't hire them, and you don't pay for anyone sitting idle. You deal with me throughout, and the result is on me.
